Leah headed toward the office and thought about what the principal would want to talk to her about. Hopefully nothing bad. Had she missed her duty morning? She could never keep track.

Eventually, she made it to the front office. She waved at Amber the older middle-aged secretary who helped keep the school running more than anyone else. The registrar, a rotund black woman, was hard at work in her office and didn't even notice as Leah passed by.

The principal's door was open, and Leah stood in the entryway as if asking for permission to come further.

"Ah, Miss Williams," he said with a smile, "come on in. Take a seat." Principal Howard stood from his desk and motioned for one of the chairs in front of his work area. He closed the door as Leah made herself comfortable.

Was that the door latch locking? Leah thought for a second but figured it probably wasn't.

"You wanted me to come by Mr. Howard?" Even though Leah had worked there for some time she always felt formality was better with the boss.

"Yes, there was something I wanted to discuss with you." He moved around his desk and took a seat.

"Of course." Leah raised an eyebrow.

"This is your tenure year, you know this correct?" The man of middle years, maybe late 40s but closer to mid-50s asked as he readjusted his tie.

"I do." Leah nodded adding "I am looking forward to it." Awkward. Oh God was he going to try to make me coach? I can't say no. Please don't ask me to coach. She worried.
